overview: The commission approved multiple one-day liquor licenses, manager and officer changes for local businesses, and an entertainment license amendment. Commissioners also held an informational discussion regarding licensing pathways for a proposed brewpub in Medford Square.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the revised minutes from September 21, 2022, and the minutes from October 19, 2022.

items.title: One-Day License: Jingle Bell Festival
items.summary: Approved a one-day beer and wine license for the Jingle Bell Festival fundraiser at City Hall on December 3, 2022, pending receipt of proof of liability insurance.

items.title: One-Day License: Winter Extravaganza
items.summary: Approved a one-day beer garden license for the city's Winter Extravaganza event at City Hall on November 30, 2022.

items.title: Change of Manager: Smashburger
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Ruben Silvestre as the new manager for Smashburger at 495 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Change of Officers and Manager: Station Landing Hotels
items.summary: Approved the addition of David Rebich as chief financial officer and the appointment of Vincent Sassone as manager for both the AC Hotel and the TownePlace Suites/Fairfield Inn & Suites at Station Landing.

items.title: Entertainment License Amendment: Amici
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the entertainment license for Amici at 21 Renan Road to permit comedians and DJs alongside existing entertainment devices.

items.title: Informational Discussion: Deep Cuts Deli
items.summary: Owner Jeff Wetzel presented plans to relocate to Medford Square as a brewpub operating with a Section 12 full alcohol license and state brewpub permit; commissioners agreed to seek clarification from the ABCC and city legal staff on local licensing procedures.

items.title: Commission Regulations and General Updates
items.summary: Commissioners discussed plans to meet in person to review and modernize local regulations, and received a brief administrative update on license renewal processing.
